auth_cache_failed_logins_expiry.description: [auth] cache_failed_logins_expiry — Expiration time of caching failed logins in seconds Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 90).

auth_cache_logins.description: [auth] cache_logins — Cache logins for until expiration time Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default false).

auth_cache_successful_logins_expiry.description: [auth] cache_successful_logins_expiry — Expiration time for caching successful logins in seconds Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 15).

auth_delay.description: [auth] delay — Incorrect authentication delay (seconds) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 1).

auth_dovecot_connection_type.description: [auth] dovecot_connection_type — Connection type for dovecot authentication (AF_UNIX|AF_INET|AF_INET6) Note: credentials are transmitted in cleartext Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default AF_UNIX).

auth_dovecot_host.description: [auth] dovecot_host — Host of via network exposed dovecot socket Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default localhost).

auth_dovecot_port.description: [auth] dovecot_port — Port of via network exposed dovecot socket Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 12345).

auth_dovecot_socket.description: [auth] dovecot_socket — The path to the Dovecot client authentication socket (eg. /run/dovecot/auth-client on Fedora). Radicale must have read / write access to the socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default /var/run/dovecot/auth-client).

auth_htpasswd_cache.description: [auth] htpasswd_cache — Enable caching of htpasswd file based on size and mtime_ns Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

auth_htpasswd_encryption.description: [auth] htpasswd_encryption — Htpasswd encryption method Value: plain | bcrypt | md5 | sha256 | sha512 | argon2 | autodetect bcrypt requires the installation of 'bcrypt' module. argon2 requires the installation of 'argon2-cffi' module. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default autodetect).

auth_htpasswd_filename.description: [auth] htpasswd_filename — Htpasswd filename Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default /etc/radicale/users).

auth_imap_host.description: [auth] imap_host — IMAP server hostname Syntax: address | address:port | [address]:port | imap.server.tld Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default localhost).

auth_imap_security.description: [auth] imap_security — Secure the IMAP connection Value: tls | starttls | none Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default tls).

auth_lc_username.description: [auth] lc_username — Convert username to lowercase, must be true for case-insensitive auth providers Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

auth_ldap_base.description: [auth] ldap_base — The base DN where the user accounts have to be searched Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default ##BASE_DN##).

auth_ldap_filter.description: [auth] ldap_filter — The filter to find the DN of the user. This filter must contain a python-style placeholder for the login Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default (&(objectClass=person)(uid={0}))).

auth_ldap_groups_attribute.description: [auth] ldap_groups_attribute — the attribute to read the group memberships from in the user's LDAP entry (default: not set) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default memberOf).

auth_ldap_ignore_attribute_create_modify.description: [auth] ldap_ignore_attribute_create_modify_timestamp — Ignore modifyTimestamp and createTimestamp attributes. Required e.g. for Authentik LDAP server Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default false).

auth_ldap_reader_dn.description: [auth] ldap_reader_dn — The reader DN of the LDAP server Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default CN=ldapreader,CN=Users,##BASE_DN##).

auth_ldap_secret.description: [auth] ldap_secret — Password of the reader DN Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default ldapreader-secret).

auth_ldap_secret_file.description: [auth] ldap_secret_file — Path of the file containing password of the reader DN Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default /run/secrets/ldap_password).

auth_ldap_security.description: [auth] ldap_security — the encryption mode to be used: tls, starttls, default is none Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default none).

auth_ldap_ssl_ca_file.description: [auth] ldap_ssl_ca_file — The path to the CA file in pem format which is used to certificate the server certificate Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

auth_ldap_ssl_verify_mode.description: [auth] ldap_ssl_verify_mode — The certificate verification mode. Works for ssl and starttls. NONE, OPTIONAL, default is REQUIRED Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default REQUIRED).

auth_ldap_uri.description: [auth] ldap_uri — URI to the LDAP server Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default ldap://localhost).

auth_ldap_use_ssl.description: [auth] ldap_use_ssl — Use ssl on the ldap connection Soon to be deprecated, use ldap_security instead Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

auth_ldap_user_attribute.description: [auth] ldap_user_attribute — the attribute holding the value to be used as username after authentication Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default cn).

auth_oauth2_token_endpoint.description: [auth] oauth2_token_endpoint — OAuth2 token endpoint URL Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default <URL>).

auth_pam_group_membership.description: [auth] pam_group_membership — PAM group user should be member of Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

auth_pam_serivce.description: [auth] pam_serivce — PAM service Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default radicale).

auth_realm.description: [auth] realm — Message displayed in the client when a password is needed Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default Radicale - Password Required).

auth_strip_domain.description: [auth] strip_domain — Strip domain name from username Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

auth_type.description: [auth] type — Authentication method Value: none | htpasswd | remote_user | http_x_remote_user | dovecot | ldap | oauth2 | pam | denyall Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default denyall).

encoding_request.description: [encoding] request — Encoding for responding requests Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default utf-8).

encoding_stock.description: [encoding] stock — Encoding for storing local collections Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default utf-8).

hook_rabbitmq_endpoint.description: [hook] rabbitmq_endpoint — [hook] rabbitmq_endpoint Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

hook_rabbitmq_queue_type.description: [hook] rabbitmq_queue_type — [hook] rabbitmq_queue_type Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default classic).

hook_rabbitmq_topic.description: [hook] rabbitmq_topic — [hook] rabbitmq_topic Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

hook_type.description: [hook] type — Hook types Value: none | rabbitmq Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default none).

logging_backtrace_on_debug.description: [logging] backtrace_on_debug — Log backtrace on level=debug Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

logging_bad_put_request_content.description: [logging] bad_put_request_content — Log bad PUT request content Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

logging_level.description: [logging] level — Threshold for the logger Value: debug | info | warning | error | critical Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default info).

logging_mask_passwords.description: [logging] mask_passwords — Don't include passwords in logs Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default True).

logging_request_content_on_debug.description: [logging] request_content_on_debug — Log request content on level=debug Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

logging_request_header_on_debug.description: [logging] request_header_on_debug — Log request header on level=debug Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

logging_response_content_on_debug.description: [logging] response_content_on_debug — Log response content on level=debug Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

logging_rights_rule_doesnt_match_on_debu.description: [logging] rights_rule_doesnt_match_on_debug — Log rights rule which doesn't match on level=debug Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

logging_storage_cache_actions_on_debug.description: [logging] storage_cache_actions_on_debug — Log storage cache actions on level=debug Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

reporting_max_freebusy_occurrence.description: [reporting] max_freebusy_occurrence — When returning a free-busy report, limit the number of returned occurences per event to prevent DOS attacks. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 10000).

rights_file.description: [rights] file — File for rights management from_file

rights_permit_delete_collection.description: [rights] permit_delete_collection — Permit delete of a collection (global) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default True).

rights_permit_overwrite_collection.description: [rights] permit_overwrite_collection — Permit overwrite of a collection (global) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default True).

rights_type.description: [rights] type — Rights backend Value: authenticated | owner_only | owner_write | from_file

server_certificate_authority.description: [server] certificate_authority — CA certificate for validating clients. This can be used to secure TCP traffic between Radicale and a reverse proxy Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

server_ciphersuite.description: [server] ciphersuite — SSL ciphersuite, secure configuration: DHE:ECDHE:-NULL:-SHA (see also "man openssl-ciphers") Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default (default)).

server_hosts.description: [server] hosts — CalDAV server hostnames separated by a comma IPv4 syntax: address:port IPv6 syntax: [address]:port Hostname syntax (using "getaddrinfo" to resolve to IPv4/IPv6 adress(es)): hostname:port For example: 0.0.0.0:9999, [::]:9999, localhost:9999 Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default localhost:5232).

server_max_connections.description: [server] max_connections — Max parallel connections Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 8).

server_max_content_length.description: [server] max_content_length — Max size of request body (bytes) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 100000000).

server_protocol.description: [server] protocol — SSL protocol, secure configuration: ALL -SSLv3 -TLSv1 -TLSv1.1 Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default (default)).

server_script_name.description: [server] script_name — script name to strip from URI if called by reverse proxy Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default (default taken from HTTP_X_SCRIPT_NAME or SCRIPT_NAME)).

server_ssl.description: [server] ssl — SSL flag, enable HTTPS protocol Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

server_timeout.description: [server] timeout — Socket timeout (seconds) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 30).

storage_filesystem_cache_folder.description: [storage] filesystem_cache_folder — Folder for storing cache of local collections, created if not present Note: only used in case of use_cache_subfolder_* options are active Note: can be used on multi-instance setup to cache files on local node (see below) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default (filesystem_folder)).

storage_filesystem_folder.description: [storage] filesystem_folder — Folder for storing local collections, created if not present Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default /var/lib/radicale/collections).

storage_folder_umask.description: [storage] folder_umask — Use configured umask for folder creation (not applicable for OS Windows) Useful value: 0077 | 0027 | 0007 | 0022 Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default (system default, usual 0022)).

storage_hook.description: [storage] hook — Command that is run after changes to storage, default is emtpy Supported placeholders: %(user)s: logged-in user %(cwd)s : current working directory %(path)s: full path of item Command will be executed with base directory defined in filesystem_folder For "git" check DOCUMENTATION.md for bootstrap instructions Example(test): echo \"user=%(user)s path=%(path)s cwd=%(cwd)s\" Example(git): git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Changes by \"%(user)s\"") Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

storage_max_sync_token_age.description: [storage] max_sync_token_age — Delete sync token that are older (seconds) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default 2592000).

storage_predefined_collections.description: [storage] predefined_collections — Create predefined user collections json format: { "def-addressbook": { "D:displayname": "Personal Address Book", "tag": "VADDRESSBOOK" }, "def-calendar": { "C:supported-calendar-component-set": "VEVENT,VJOURNAL,VTODO", "D:displayname": "Personal Calendar", "tag": "VCALENDAR" } } Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

storage_skip_broken_item.description: [storage] skip_broken_item — Skip broken item instead of triggering an exception Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default True).

storage_type.description: [storage] type — Storage backend Value: multifilesystem | multifilesystem_nolock Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default multifilesystem).

storage_use_cache_subfolder_for_history.description: [storage] use_cache_subfolder_for_history — Use subfolder 'collection-cache' for 'history' cache file structure instead of inside collection folder Note: use only on single-instance setup, will break consistency with client in multi-instance setup Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

storage_use_cache_subfolder_for_item.description: [storage] use_cache_subfolder_for_item — Use subfolder 'collection-cache' for 'item' cache file structure instead of inside collection folder Note: can be used on multi-instance setup to cache 'item' on local node Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

storage_use_cache_subfolder_for_synctoke.description: [storage] use_cache_subfolder_for_synctoken — Use subfolder 'collection-cache' for 'sync-token' cache file structure instead of inside collection folder Note: use only on single-instance setup, will break consistency with client in multi-instance setup Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

storage_use_mtime_and_size_for_item_cach.description: [storage] use_mtime_and_size_for_item_cache — Use last modifiction time (nanoseconds) and size (bytes) for 'item' cache instead of SHA256 (improves speed) Note: check used filesystem mtime precision before enabling Note: conversion is done on access, bulk conversion can be done offline using storage verification option: radicale --verify-storage Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default False).

web_type.description: [web] type — Web interface backend Value: none | internal Unset keeps the shipped commented line (default internal).
